title: Creatures that cannot report may still have higher-order thoughts

statements.text: Reportability fixes which states count as conscious in creatures that can speak, but what matters is the higher-order thought, not the report. Infants and many mammals can think, so whether they have the needed higher-order thoughts is open to finding out.

sources.quote: So if a creature were unable to express any of its higher-order thoughts, that would not imply that it had none.
it is open to find out whether they have at least some HOTs of the requisite kind
